review: independent bounded audit of historical_credit_coverage.py and its public source-only outputs
kind: read-only source-identity and mechanism review; no economic outcome, no option or market data, no JEV or model call, no text classifier, no regex eligibility estimate

decision.source_feasible_label_meaning: raw sparsity result only; not a clean cohort, not a mechanism, not a direction, not an effect

unresolved_cik_claim.meaning: every enrolled direct-ticker row carries a cik field; this is not a resolution of tickerless all-filer rows
unresolved_cik_claim.mechanism: historical_credit_coverage.py:365 enroll() drops any row without a direct canonical ticker before CIK is read; unresolved_cik_rows at historical_credit_coverage.py:377 counts only enrolled rows lacking a cik field; no identity evidence is consulted
unresolved_cik_claim.conclusion: zero unresolved CIK rows means only enrolled rows are CIK-complete, not that all tickerless all-filer rows were resolved

identity_unresolved_residual.evidence_base: the 20 source-only 2024-2025 files in SOURCE_IDENTITY_REVIEW.json; novelty_results/source_filings.json excluded; no 2023 reserved metadata and no old novelty cache read
identity_unresolved_residual.claim: the 147 / 54 direct counts are a lower bound; the identity-unresolved residual is about 1923 to 2026 accessions over the four-year union; unknown issuers stay explicit and are not inferred
identity_unresolved_residual.caveat: the residual is a property of the local git-ignored evidence cache, not reproducible from committed files alone

reserved_window_exposure_ledger.what_was_read: cached filing metadata only (cik, ticker, accession, filing_date, items_text); no reserved financial data, no option price, no payoff, no new source request
reserved_window_exposure_ledger.status: excluded from the identity corpus and not read again; the historical credit acquisition itself never touched the holdout
reserved_window_exposure_ledger.cannot_restore: a previously cached file cannot be made pristine again
reserved_window_exposure_ledger.judge_window: the actual judge-selected reserved window is unknown because the judges set HOLDOUT_START..HOLDOUT_END
reserved_window_exposure_ledger.claim_boundary: this review does not claim the sealed data was entirely untouched

documentation_corrections.complete_population_claim: corrected: direct-ticker raw population with an identity-unresolved residual of about 2026 accessions, not a complete census
documentation_corrections.cik_recovery_claim: corrected: CIK is read from an existing field, it is not resolved from identity evidence
documentation_corrections.source_novel_claim: corrected: extending the tag count to earlier years changes the source window, not an economic fact
documentation_corrections.cash_secured_put_example: corrected: no option price or strategy outcome was read; mechanism and expression are untested

source_rule_checks.repurchase_report_generator: repurchase_source_audit.py remains a frozen historical snapshot; its unqualified census conclusions are superseded by SOURCE_IDENTITY_REVIEW.md; generator not edited and hashes unchanged

next_direction_note: the frozen report's recommended small fixed outcome-blind numerical-source-term audit (facility size, current and prior maturity, renewal/extension timing) is sound and remains not built and not run here; the credit-facility terms pilot is owned by another worker and is not touched
